source_notes.citation: Conservation X Labs. [MiewID-msv3 upload commit](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3/commit/5ff899ef579bebdabc9482aafabe96cfac027060), 15 October 2024; [commit history](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3/commits/main); [release file inventory](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3/tree/main). Used for release identity, chronology and available artifacts.

Conservation X Labs. [MiewID-msv3 model.safetensors file metadata](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3/blob/main/model.safetensors). Publisher SHA-256 compared with the local cached file; comparison recorded in the accompanying JSON.
Conservation X Labs. [MiewID-msv2 model card](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv2), Eurasian lynx row under Detailed results. Explicit annotation/name training and test counts.

Lasha Otarashvili, Tamilselvan Subramanian, Jason Holmberg, J.J. Levenson and Charles V. Stewart. [Multispecies Animal Re-ID Using a Large Community-Curated Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05602), December 2024, Sections 3.2–3.3, Table 1 and acknowledgements. Table text also available in the [author-uploaded paper](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/386577080_Multispecies_Animal_Re-ID_Using_a_Large_Community-Curated_Dataset). The table describes the collected dataset, not v3’s exact training split.
Wild Me. [MiewID v4 Announcement](https://community.wildme.org/t/miewid-v4-announcement/5406), 30 January 2026. Identifies the paper’s model as v2 and distinguishes later versions.

Conservation X Labs. [MiewID-msv3 model card](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3), Training Data and Evaluation Results. Public description of training sources and Eurasian lynx evaluation; no image-level source manifest supplied.

Wild Me. wbia-plugin-miew-id: [default training configuration](https://github.com/WildMeOrg/wbia-plugin-miew-id/blob/main/wbia_miew_id/configs/default_config.yaml), [dataset-related exclusions](https://github.com/WildMeOrg/wbia-plugin-miew-id/blob/main/wbia_miew_id/.gitignore), and [deployment model configuration](https://github.com/WildMeOrg/wbia-plugin-miew-id/blob/main/wbia_miew_id/configs/model_config.json). Inspected repository state; these files are not a verified recipe for the pinned v3 release.

Hugging Face community. [MiewID-msv3 discussion: msv2 versus msv3](https://huggingface.co/conservationxlabs/miewid-msv3/discussions/1), opened May 2025. Third-party discussion, not publisher confirmation of training membership.

Lukáš Picek et al. [CzechLynx preprint record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04931), first submitted 5 June 2025; [revised paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.04931v2), source-collection table and earlier-study discussion; [Scientific Data article](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-026-06853-9), 24 February 2026. These are versions of the same work, not independent corroborating datasets.

Lukáš Picek, Lukáš Neumann and Jiří Matas. [Animal Identification with Independent Foreground and Background Modeling](https://arxiv.org/html/2408.12930v1), 23 August 2024, Section 4 and access footnote. Earlier Czech lynx collection and access conditions.

LIFE Lynx. [C5 annual report](https://www.lifelynx.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/LIFE-Lynx-C5-annual-report_FINAL.pdf), April 2024 hosting path, p. 10. Whiskerbook upload counts and monitoring years verified from the indexed passage; the complete large PDF was not available for review. No training-membership claim is inferred.

Silvia Blašković, Magda Sindičić, Maureen Reilly, Ira Topličanec and Tomislav Gomerčić. [Spotted correctly? Human expertise remains essential in AI-assisted identification of Eurasian lynx](https://zslpublications.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/jzo.70095), first published 22 December 2025; Journal of Zoology 328(3), 223–233 (2026). Publisher abstract and [public photo resource](http://lynx.vef.hr/public/); full methods were not available for review.
